SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF SEP-18-2018 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF SEP-18-2018 BY CHRISTINE VAN AKEN. 506 PLAINTIFF JAMAAR NELSON IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT KALIK BROWN IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT LUCILLE SMITH IS NOT PRESENT. NO PROOF OF SERVICE FOR DEFENDANT LUCILLE SMITH. PLAINTIFF REQUESTS TO DISMISS LUCILLE SMITH AS A DEFENDANT ON OPEN RECORD. PLAINTIFF & DEFENDANT EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: CHRISTINE VAN AKEN; CLERK: G. FELICIANO; NOT REPORTED. 506
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF SEP-18-2018 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF NELSON, JAAMAR RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT BROWN, KALIK $1,070.00 PRINCIPAL, TOTAL JUDGMENT $1,070.00, DEFENDANT MAY RETAIN DEPOSIT FOR DAMAGE TO DOORS BUT NOT CARPET AT THE END OF ITS USEFUL LIFE. THE COURT FINDS THE SECURITY DEPOSIT WAS $1600.00, NOT $1400.00. LUCILLE SMITH IS DISMISSED FROM THIS CASE; JUDGMENT RUNS ONLY AGAINST KALIK BROWN. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
ORDER OF EXAMINATION ISSUED AS TO DEFENDANT BROWN, KALIK HEARING SET FOR DEC-27-2018 AT 11:00 AM IN DEPT 506
EXHIBITS FROM EXHIBIT REPORT DATED DEC-03-2018 ORDERED DESTROYED
